name: Machine Seated Leg Raise Crunch
aliases: Seated Ab Machine with Leg Raise
steps: Sit in a compound abdominal crunch machine with your feet hooked behind the lower foot pads and your hands gripping the upper handles near your shoulders.
Brace your abs and sit tall with your back lightly against the pad.
Exhale and simultaneously curl your upper torso forward while drawing your knees upward toward your chest.
Pause briefly in the fully contracted position, then return your torso and legs slowly back to the start without letting the stack rest.
tips: Lead the movement by flexing your abs rather than pulling hard with your arms.
Keep the ribs and knees moving toward each other rather than letting either lever swing on its own.
